versions.changelog:
Initial release of m5stack-firmware-query.

- Provides read-only queries against the public M5Burner firmware repository.
- Supports search by keyword, device, category, functional intent, firmware ID, version, developer, UIFlow2 releases, recommendations, rankings, and comments.
- Returns live data; all API interactions are performed at the time of the query.
- Enforces strict read-only operation—no uploads, edits, downloads, or account actions.
- Includes clear guidelines on query workflow, available commands, and handling hardware variants.
- Supplies sample command-line usage for common discovery tasks.
